name: voc-openapi-mcp
stderr:
Specify one supported target with --agent <ID>. Run list-agents to see supported IDs.

Usage:
  voc-mcp setup --agent <ID> [--api-key <VOC_API_KEY>] [--api-base <URL>] [--url <URL>] [--name <NAME>] [--with-skill] [--config <PATH>] [--dry-run]
  voc-mcp uninstall --agent <ID> [--name <NAME>] [--config <PATH>] [--dry-run]
  voc-mcp list-agents

Examples:
  npx voc-openapi-mcp@latest setup --agent codex
  npx voc-openapi-mcp@latest setup --agent codex --with-skill
  npx voc-openapi-mcp@latest setup --agent cursor
  npx voc-openapi-mcp@latest setup --agent claude-code --api-key voc_live_sk_xxx
  npx voc-openapi-mcp@latest uninstall --agent codex

Supported agents: claude-code, claude-desktop, cursor, windsurf, workbuddy, gemini-cli, codex
